title: Neutral Adapter Descriptor
description: A versioned, package-format-independent descriptor of one adapter at the common facade. It states the runtime category, the operations it serves, the invocation transport and the capabilities it requires -- never a package-format kind taxonomy, a service requirement or a distribution/provisioning decision. Runtime category, invocation transport, package format/kind and distribution are independent axes. Domain payloads keep their own schemas; this descriptor composes them, it does not replace them, and it creates no WorkContract and no gate acceptance authority.

schema_version.description: Version of this descriptor contract, not of the adapter.

id.description: Consumer-unique adapter id. Opaque; never matched against a vendor list.

categories.description: Runtime categories this adapter registers under. A category is a runtime role, not a package kind. The v1 set is closed: an unknown category fails closed rather than being coerced onto a nearest match.

operations.description: Operations served, each bound to its own domain contracts. The facade resolves by category+operation+capability; it never invents an operation.

transport.description: Invocation transport binding (e.g. http, mcp-stdio, in-process). Independent of package format and of runtime category.

credential_refs.description: References to credentials by id. A descriptor NEVER carries a credential value; availability is resolved and gated at call time.

package_ref.description: Neutral provenance for a descriptor produced by a package-format reader. Opaque format/version/artifact references only; no reader-specific kind enum is interpreted by the common facade. There is no 'credential_value' field anywhere in the descriptor: a persisted credential is an additional property and fails closed.

kind.description: Opaque package-format kind. Deliberately an open string, never an enum: the common facade must not branch on a format-specific vocabulary.

allOf.description: A container-root package_ref must name the admitted member it binds; a container with no member is refused before load.
